name: Creamy Sausage and Broccoli Rigatoni
steps: Remove casings from sausages and crumble the meat.
Chop tenderstem broccoli and dice the onion.
Thinly slice garlic cloves.
Cook rigatoni in a pot of salted boiling water.
In a large pan, sauté the sausage meat in olive oil until browned.
Add diced onion and continue cooking until softened.
Add sliced garlic and sauté.
Add chopped broccoli and splash in some pasta water.
In a bowl, mix grated Parmesan cheese with egg yolks, black pepper, salt, and a splash of warm pasta water to form a smooth paste.
Transfer cooked rigatoni directly to the pan with sausage and broccoli.
Pour in the egg and cheese mixture, stirring continuously off or on very low heat to create a creamy sauce.
Serve topped with extra grated Parmesan, black pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil.
author: mush.kitchen

name: Caesar Parmesan Potato Salad
ingredients: 1kg Baby Potatoes, halved and boiled until fork tender
Seasoning for potatoes - i’m using zest chicken salt
steps: In a blender, add all of your caesar ingredients and blitz until smooth. In the video I did it all by hand which you can also do but in the blender is quicker and tastes the same. Set dressing in the fridge until ready to use
In a pot of cold, salted water, add your potatoes, bring to a boil and strain once they’re fork tender
Place a lid on top of your strainer and shake about to get craggily bits on your potato which help the crisping process
Preheat oven at 220c and add your baking tray with either olive oil, duck fat or tallow and heat for 5 minutes then add your potatoes
Cook for 45 minutes, flipping 2-3 times so all sides become crispy
In a cold pan, add your guanciale and cook on medium heat stirring occasionally until nice and crispy then strain
Add to a bowl your crispy seasoned potatoes, guanciale, parsley, parmesan and caesar, toss to combine and serve
author: nunnamaryskitchen

name: Braised Beef Cheeks
steps: Season beef cheeks with salt.
Sear beef cheeks in a hot, oiled pan until deep brown crust forms on both sides, then remove.
Add carrots and shallots to the pan and soften for 5 to 10 minutes.
Add rosemary and halved garlic bulb.
Add tomato paste and cook out the tartness.
Pour in red wine.
Nestle beef cheeks back into the pan and top up with stout.
Cover with a parchment paper cartouche and the lid.
Bake in the oven at 150°C for around 4.5 hours.
Remove beef cheeks and strain the braising liquid into a saucepan.
Bring the liquid to a simmer to reduce.
Whisk in cold butter until glossy.
Return beef cheeks to the sauce to heat through.
Serve over mashed potatoes, spoon sauce over top, and garnish with chopped chives.
author: jack_munn

name: Roasted Carrot And Chickpea Farro Salad
ingredients: 4-5 medium carrots, sliced thickly on a bias (270 g)
1 (14 oz or 400 g) can of chickpeas, drained and rinsed
Diamond Crystal kosher salt and olive oil for roasting
45 g (3 tbsp) extra virgin olive oil
1/3 cup (45 g) roughly chopped raw hazelnuts
2 tsp oregano buds or Italian herbs*
1 tbsp fresh chopped Calabrian chili in oil**
steps: Bring a small pot of water to a boil, and add the farro along with a generous pinch of kosher salt. Lower the heat to medium-low and simmer until the farro is tender but still has some bite. Drain the farro in a strainer and set aside.

Preheat the oven to 450°F convection and line a quarter sheet pan with parchment paper. Slice the carrots on a bias, about ¼ inch thick, and add to the prepared pan along with the chickpeas. Drizzle generously with extra virgin olive oil, sprinkle with salt, and toss to coat. Roast for 22-25 minutes until the carrots have caramelized and are slightly browned, and the chickpeas are crisp and a dark, golden brown.
Finely mince the shallot and add it to a medium mixing bowl (large enough to toss the final salad in). Add in the lemon juice, honey, and kosher salt, and stir well. Set aside.

Add the oil, hazelnuts, and minced garlic to a small pan or skillet. Sauté over medium heat for 2-3 minutes, or until the garlic is fragrant. Sprinkle in the fennel seeds and fry for an additional 1 minute. Take off the heat and stir in the dried oregano and chopped Calabrian chili.

Add the farro, roasted carrots, and chickpeas (along with any residual oil from the pan), minced parsley, and dressing to the bowl with the macerated shallots. Toss together, taste, and adjust for salt. Serve immediately – tastes best warm.
author: munchingwithmariyah

name: Science Based Fudgy Crackle Top Brownies
steps: Melt the butter and chopped dark chocolate in a bowl set over a pot of boiling water.
Remove from the heat source and whisk in the cocoa powder and salt to bloom.
In a separate bowl, add the eggs, white sugar, brown sugar, and vanilla extract.
Whisk on high speed with a hand mixer until thick and doubled in volume.
Pour in the melted chocolate mixture while whisking on low speed until combined.
Add the flour and dark chocolate chunks, then fold with a spatula until no streaks of flour remain.
Pour the batter into a parchment-lined square baking tin and nudge it to the edges without spreading the top smooth.
Bake at 140°C for 34 minutes, or until the internal temperature reaches 88°C.
Remove from the oven and leave to cool and chill for 2 hours until the internal temperature drops to 30°C.
Slice into squares and serve.
author: dumpedlingss

name: Mexican Street Corn Salad
ingredients: 1 bunch of fresh cilantro, finely chopped
steps: Char the corn: Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the drained corn and season with salt, black pepper, and paprika. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the corn is golden with slightly charred spots.
Let it cool: Remove the corn from the heat and allow it to cool before assembling the salad.
Add the fresh ingredients: Transfer the cooled corn to a large bowl. Add the finely chopped red onion, jalapeños, and cilantro.
Make it creamy: Add the minced garlic, mayonnaise, freshly squeezed lime juice, and crumbled Cotija cheese.
Mix and serve: Toss everything together until well combined. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
author: azzastouch

name: Moldovan Baba Neagra
ingredients: 1 tbsp vodka or other high proof liquor
steps: THOROUGHLY grease and flour a baking dish
Whisk eggs, sugar, vanilla, and salt until frothy at the top
In another bowl, add each of the remaining ingredients in order except the vodka, whisking thoroughly between each.
After the baking soda let it sit for about 5 mins to get bubbly
Whisk the two mixtures and vodka together until uniform
Pour batter into the prepared pan and wrap it fully with foil so that it is as airtight as possible
Bake for 1.5 hours at 200c/390f, then 1.5 hours more at 150c/300f. Don’t open the oven
Let cool for at least an hour as it will be very hot
Enjoy this unique confection!
author: foodeatingfun

name: One Pan Banoffee Upside Down Cake
steps: Make your cake batter by adding your butter and sugar to a bowl and whisking until the butter turns pale and fluffy (electric whisk or mixer would be most ideal)
Add your eggs, milk and vanilla extract and whisk through
Go in with your flour and fold through until there’s no more white flour bits
For the banoffee, in a pan over a medium heat, add your butter and melt until foamy
Add in your light brown sugar and mix through until combined. Add a splash of boiling water and whisk vigorously if it splits
Turn the heat to low and do your bananas carefully cut side down
Turn the heat off and gently spoon your cake batter over the top being careful not to mix it with the caramel
Get it in the oven for 35 minutes at 170oC
Flip out onto a plate and serve up with a big dollop of ice cream
author: abowlofstew

name: Kewpie Mayo
steps: Bring the eggs to room temperature before separating the yolks & whites.
Add the yolks to a mason jar along with a splash of rice vinegar, the juice of 1/2 a lemon, a heaping tsp of dijon mustard, and pinches of salt, MSG, and sugar.
Add just over a cup of neutral oil (avocado or similar) to the jar, then use an immersion blender to whip until smooth and creamy— about a minute or so.
Use immediately, or store in an airtight container in the fridge up to a week.
author: detroit75kitchen

name: Kewpie Mayo
steps: Add the neutral oil, egg yolks, sugar, rice wine vinegar, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, and MSG to a tall jar.
Place an immersion blender at the bottom of the jar directly over the yolks and seasonings.
Blend on medium-low for a few seconds until the base begins to emulsify and thicken.
Increase the blender speed and slowly pull the immersion blender upward to incorporate the remaining oil until completely smooth and thick.
author: scupeats

name: One Pot Spicy Creamy Rigatoni Pasta
ingredients: ½ tbsp Red Chilli Flakes (adjust to your preference)
steps: Heat a splash of vegetable oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add diced shallots and garlic, and sauté until softened.
Pour in passata.
Add salt, black pepper, the spice blend, dried oregano, and fresh basil, then stir through.
Pour in vegetable stock, turn up the heat, and bring to a simmer.
Add 400 g rigatoni pasta and a sprinkle of salt.
Cook until the pasta is tender and the sauce has reduced.
Turn off the heat and stir in mascarpone cheese until creamy.
Squeeze in fresh lemon juice.
Grate parmesan cheese over the top.
Finish with extra chili flakes, lemon zest, and fresh basil.
author: whatinthechef

name: Peanut Chilli Noodles
steps: Cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large bowl, combine the garlic, peanut butter, chopped peanuts, tahini, tamari, chilli oil, lime juice, water, + sesame seeds.
Whisk until the sauce is creamy + glossy. The hot water will help the fats from the tahini + peanut butter emulsify perfectly.
Add the cooked noodles + most of the chopped scallions to the bowl.
Toss thoroughly so every strand is coated in that elite sauce.
Garnish with the remaining scallions + an extra sprinkle of sesame seeds.
Serve immediately.
author: clairesharrynroberto
